shorts_extract.hook: Give neuroscientists two cheap paintbrushes and a piece of cardboard, and in 60 seconds they can make your brain swear a dead rubber glove is your own hand.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Botvinick & Cohen (1998 Nature, 23 mm vs 13 mm drift) + Ehrsson et al. (2004 Science) premotor fMRI + Tsakiris & Haggard (2005) + Torregrossa & Park (2022).
shorts_extract.twist: Why a 500-ms brush delay or wooden block breaks the spell instantly, Lush's 2020 suggestibility critique, and how adult brains embody everyday tools and rehab mirrors.
